standard.summary: 启用分层学习率训练（只支持 networks.* 系列网络模块）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Enables per-layer learning rates (supported on the networks.* network modules only).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启用分层学习率训练（只支持网络模块 networks.lora）。开启后可在下方分别设置 U-Net Encoder / Mid / Decoder 各层的学习率权重，精细控制模型各部分的训练强度

advanced_en.principle: Enables per-layer learning-rate training (only supports the networks.lora network module). When on, you can set learning-rate weights separately for each U-Net Encoder / Mid / Decoder layer to finely control training intensity per part of the model.
